summary: PLDT Inc. filed a Form 6-K with an attached SEC Form 17-Q quarterly report for the period ended March 31, 2026. The filing is a routine periodic report containing management's discussion and analysis and unaudited consolidated financial statements. It does not disclose any special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, restructuring, or management change. As a foreign private issuer filing a quarterly report under cover of Form 6-K, this is an ordinary compliance submission with no transactional or extraordinary corporate action.
